FR-45: at least one resource POI in the demo plan. Its ISRU framing is assumed. Slope suitability of stop 2 is not checked: the real grid is not on disk yet, TODO(verify) after the T03.19 bundle exists.
stop_picks.poi-monte-grande-hollow: Stop 3, science: the hollow half of the ridge/hollow pair started at stop 1. The walk now backtracks north from the sulfate contact to the hollow (latitudes read from the POI files). Slope suitability is TODO(verify) until the T03.19 bundle exists.
